hook_text: 0,5 or 0,25: which is bigger? If you said 0,25, this swimming race is for you.
clip_script: Swimming gala in Durban! Megan: 34,98 seconds. Lerato: 35,09. Sipho: 35,4. Who won? Start on the left. 34 wholes beats 35 wholes, so Megan is fastest. Now Lerato and Sipho. Both 35. Check the tenths: 0 against 4. Lerato wins that one! The 9 is only hundredths. Add a zero and line up the commas: 35,09 and 35,40. Easy. And 0,5 is 0,50, so it beats 0,25. Wholes, then tenths, then hundredths!
visual_style: A swimming pool seen from above with lane ropes, a big scoreboard of times with the decimal commas lining up and zeros sliding into empty places.
mood: Exciting and splashy, like a gala commentator.
pacing: Fast race start, a pause at the scoreboard, then quick comparisons place by place.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and order the five swimmers from first to fifth.
